name: ecom Tab-Ex Pro DZ2
summary: The ecom Tab-Ex Pro DZ2 is an intrinsically safe (Ex ic) 10.1-inch Android tablet from ecom (Pepperl+Fuchs), certified for Zone 2/22 under ATEX and IECEx. It runs Android 11. It has been discontinued; the ecom Tab-Ex 04 Pro DZ2 replaces it.
imageAlt: ecom Tab-Ex Pro DZ2, front view

atex.marking: II 3G Ex ic IIC T5 Gc / II 3D Ex ic IIIB T80°C Dc
atex.status: IECEx Current, checked 2026-10-25. Product discontinued. There was no 'Tab-Ex Pro DZ1': this model is Zone 2 only.

iecex.marking: Ex ic IIC T5 Gc / Ex ic IIIB T80°C Dc

certification.northAmerica: SGS: Class I, Division 2, Groups A,B,C,D T5; Class I, Zone 2, Group IIC, T5; Ta −20 °C to +55 °C

safety.conditions: Charging and wired data (USB, POGO) and battery/SD/SIM changes only in ordinary locations; Ex-protective case conductive coating inspected; protect from UV, static (IECEx EPS 20.0050X).

unconfirmed.launchYear: Approximate: the maker doesn't publish a launch date. Based on the certificate date or the maker's announcement.

strengths: ATEX and IECEx certified, with published certificate numbers
Among the lightest Zone 2 tablets of its size we list, at 930 g in use
limitations: Discontinued; the ecom Tab-Ex 04 Pro DZ2 replaces it
Zone 2 only, so not for Zone 1 areas
T5 temperature class: fine for most gases, but not those that ignite below 100 °C
Dust group IIIB: combustible flyings and non-conductive dust only, not conductive dust
